name: Get Player Pawn
description: Returns the pawn possessed by the player controller at the specified player index. Will not include pawns of remote clients with no available player controller. Target is Gameplay Statics.

inputs.name: World Context Object
inputs.description: Object used to resolve the world. Usually self or hidden when called from an actor.

inputs.name: Player Index
inputs.description: Index in the player controller list, starting first with local players (0 = first local player) and then available remote ones.

outputs.name: Return Value
outputs.description: The pawn possessed by the player controller at the given index, or null if none. Always validate with Is Valid before use.
